Independent review of r-20261005T143708493246-ped-lock-matplotlib at head fa4630b3 against base 9d21ef7b (plan imas-ambix:project-environment-declared §4). The node refreshes matplotlib in uv.lock from 3.10.9 to 3.11.2, the newest release the bare (unpinned) declaration admits, and changes no other package version. Read the reviewed worktree's two commits (fd0f52a4, fa4630b3), its manifest, its two gate logs and the new evidence fragment. The worktree was clean at fa4630b3; this review changed nothing in it. The change is uv.lock (the single matplotlib package block) plus one new evidence fragment, no product source touched.

Verified independently by reproduction, not by reading the worker's log. Extracted the reviewed head tree to a node-local scratch dir with ../nova and ../imas-ink symlinked to the real checkouts, as the gate specifies. (1) SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=0.0.0 UV_OFFLINE=0 uv lock --check exits 0. (2) uv lock --upgrade-package matplotlib against the head lock changes no version, so 3.11.2 is the newest the declaration admits. (4) pyproject.toml is unchanged between base and head and declares matplotlib bare at pyproject.toml:71.

Gaps, all low severity, none blocking. (1) The evidence fragment file ends without a trailing newline. (2) The node is dispatched under plan §4, whose text and done-when describe the fresh-environment proof and do not name a matplotlib lock refresh; the refresh serves that aim but the placement is the coordinator's call. No added test failures: the reviewed manifest declares no baseline_suite/after_suite arms and carries no test file in scope.
